request: Inbound firewall validation must reject, with an invalid-remote-IP error, a peer claiming a source address that shares its certificate address subnet but is neither its certified host address nor within its certified unsafe networks, even when a firewall rule otherwise allows the traffic.

defects.description: Published bug fixed upstream: Fix incorrect CIDR construction in hostmap (#1493)
defects.why_missed: The project's own suite at the parent commit never exercised this input; the fix commit added the test that does.
